title: National Clean Energy Grid Expansion Launched in New Delhi
description: Ministry of Power announces a new high-capacity solar-wind hybrid transmission corridor connecting northern state grids to boost renewable efficiency.

title: Fintech Innovation Summit 2026 Convenes in Mumbai
description: Financial leaders and fintech pioneers gather at BKC to showcase real-time cross-border UPI settlements and next-generation fraud detection systems.

title: New AI & DeepTech Incubator Inaugurated in Bengaluru
description: Karnataka Minister for IT inaugurates a state-of-the-art R&D center offering supercomputing clusters to AI startups and semiconductor researchers.

title: Chennai Autonomous Electric Bus Corridor Trials Begin
description: Tamil Nadu Transport Department initiates pilot runs for self-driving electric buses along the Outer Ring Road to reduce urban emissions.

title: Genome Research & Biotech Hub Unveiled in Hyderabad
description: Genome Valley expands with a new multi-tenant facility focused on mRNA vaccine manufacturing and personalized cancer therapeutics.

title: Kolkata Heritage Riverfront Revitalization Milestone
description: Port authorities complete phase one of the Hooghly promenade, adding solar-powered walkways, eco-friendly jetties, and cultural plazas.

title: Solar & Battery Storage Facility Completed in Ahmedabad
description: Gujarat Energy Corporation commissions a 500MW solar park equipped with grid-scale lithium-ion battery storage near GIFT City.

title: EV Battery R&D Center Opens in Pune Automotive Belt
description: Leading automaker opens an advanced testing laboratory in Chakan focused on solid-state battery chemistry and fast-charging safety protocols.

title: Jaipur International Craft and Heritage Expo Opens
description: Artisans from across Rajasthan and South Asia assemble to display traditional textiles, blue pottery, and sustainable handicraft innovations.

title: Kochi Green Hydrogen Water Metro Fleet Unveiled
description: Kochi Metro Rail Limited expands its inland waterway network with zero-emission green hydrogen ferries serving island communities.

title: Srinagar Eco-Tourism and High-Altitude Observatory Station
description: Jammu & Kashmir Tourism Department commissions an atmospheric observation facility and eco-resort monitoring Himalayan glacier health.

title: Chandigarh Green Architecture & Zero-Carbon Building Summit
description: Architects and urban planners present net-zero commercial skyscraper designs featuring vertical forests and greywater recycling systems.

title: Lucknow Metro Phase 2 Smart Signaling Corridor Inauguration
description: Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation implements AI-powered moving-block signals to cut train headways to under 90 seconds.

title: Bhopal Smart Agri-Tech Expo Demonstrates Drones for Crop Yields
description: Farmers and agritech founders gather to test spectral imaging drones and automated drip irrigation nodes across central farmland.

title: Patna River Freight Terminal Opens on National Waterway 1
description: Inland Waterways Authority launches a modern container terminal on Ganga river to lower freight transport costs to northeastern states.

title: Guwahati Bio-Diversity Research Park Opens in Brahmaputra Valley
description: Assam Bio-Science Council establishes a research hub protecting flora and fauna endemic to the Eastern Himalayas and Northeast corridor.

title: Indore Wins India's Cleanest Smart City Award for 7th Year
description: Urban development survey awards Indore top honors for zero-waste landfill processing, automated street sweeping, and bio-methanation plants.

title: Surat Textile Innovation Hub Unveils Recycled Fiber Fabric
description: Textile association demonstrates zero-water dying techniques and circular polyester yarn produced entirely from ocean plastic waste.

title: Visakhapatnam Deepwater Port Expansion Phase 3 Complete
description: Andhra Pradesh Maritime Board inaugurates two extra deep-draft berths capable of handling ultra-large container vessels.

title: Goa International Blue Economy & Ocean Tourism Summit
description: Delegates from 25 maritime nations convene in Panaji to frame sustainable marine tourism policies and coastal conservation protocols.
